title: Research: close the eight register words left open by PR800 (no kappa)
body:
PR800 left eight fixed eight-call Clifford register words unclassified. This package excludes all eight for every invertible complex choice of their four scalar 3-by-3 blocks. Together with PR705's 64 exclusions and Jeremy Diviney's PR800 exclusion of `evolved-27`, the unchanged 73-word corpus is now completely excluded. The general m=3, W=3, s=8 problem remains open; **no new kappa or positive primitive is claimed**.

The additional necessary condition uses augmentation: the formal word augments to a product of invertible scalar blocks, so active permitted endpoint paths must admit a perfect matching. Five words close with this condition and Boolean resolution alone. `evolved-11` additionally uses PR800's Laurent frame exclusions; `evolved-24` and `evolved-31` need 67 exact polynomial identities after justified diagonal-gauge normalization. The checker validates every premise of each blocking clause.

The standalone verifier imports no search algorithm, numerical solver, network client or sibling research package. It reconstructs all 2,187 full paths in the nine heterogeneous words using both signed tableaus and exact Gaussian matrices; checks 490 Laurent certificates, 67 polynomial identities and 5,342 resolution clauses; and replays the inherited rank-homogeneous screen on all 73 source words. Concrete matrices are never treated as a linearly independent group-algebra basis.

Reproduce with standard-library Python:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/endpoint-matching-obstructions/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/endpoint-matching-obstructions/validate.py
```

Both commands pass on Windows x86_64 with Python 3.14.4 and 3.12.14. Three valid nine-call endpoints and six mathematical corruption controls pass. Package controls check relocation to a path with spaces, equivalent recompression of both payloads, corrupted source/payload, repinned missing coverage and resolution corruption, and explicit optimized-mode rejection. The current selected-record check, its five tests and 12 proof-binding tests pass on base `47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0` at conditional kappa `1661957774647029/10^18`. Full repository regeneration, selected-supplier cold replay, Linux execution, hosted CI, independent human review and proof-assistant formalization are not claimed.

Only `research/endpoint-matching-obstructions/` is added. PR800's weighted criterion, source proof and notice are retained with exact hashes; PR705's unchanged corpus/screen/proof and PR680's model/dense arithmetic retain credit. The model and open problem retain eumemic's PR288 and the Swapnil Jain/upstream lineage. PR836's unitary-mixing obstruction and PR720's abelian-bit theorem have distinct scopes. Selected certificates and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Prepared by littleBro with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0. This supplies eight new fixed-word exclusions and a reusable necessary filter, not a general lower bound or a priority claim for elementary matching, resolution or gauge methods.
